source: Live TallyPrime Silver 7.1 read of the synthetic company WR2 Unicode Lab through the raw serial sender of a lab sitting that made reads only: no import and no write
request_rendered_by: ReadOnlyProfile::StandardLedgerCatalogV2 { company }.render() (V1's request plus the one NativeMethod line IsBillWiseOn)
content: The import family's ledger catalogue as the V2 profile reads it: 9 ledgers with name, GUID, parent, the company GUID and name computes, and ISBILLWISEON on every row (2 Yes, 7 No).
provenance_limit: One synthetic book on one build, read once (not a paired read). It shows how Tally answers this request for these shapes; it is not evidence about a client's book or a large book. The book may have changed since its 6 Sep V1 capture of the same name.
sensitivity_review: Synthetic company, synthetic ledger names and GUIDs; no client, GSTIN, address or credential.
